excerpt.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
excerpt.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.

scope.zh: 遗物激活、夺取与失去三个窗口的触发和效果已核对。
scope.en: The triggers and effects of the relic activation, seizing and losing windows were checked.

texts.zh: 生活与其说是一场竞赛，不如说是碰运气。
texts.en: Life is more of a lottery than a competition.
Sometimes buckets weigh more than they have to.
One sapient's garbage is another sapient's treasure.

texts.zh: 不良能量币信贷总是会出现。
texts.en: A bad energy credit always turns up.

texts.zh: 闪光的未必都是暗物质。
texts.en: All that glitters is not dark matter.

texts.zh: 乞丐可不应该挑肥拣瘦。
不要苛求别人送来的泽珞是否纯净。
texts.en: Never look a gift Zarkaluvian in the buccal cavity.

texts.zh: 为溅出的泽珞哭泣是没有用的。
texts.en: It's no use crying over spilt Zro.
Let the punishment fit the crime.

notes.zh: 评注：迦拉特隆（遗物 r_galatron）激活时弹出，随机十选一的奖励各权重10：合金5000（出现两次）、能量8000、矿物8000、食物8000、次级文物300、稀有水晶500、易爆微粒500、消费品5000、异星气体500（events/caravaneer_events.txt:4338-4352）。获得途径见行商联盟主菜单的圣物箱（event-cara-333）。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron (relic r_galatron) is activated; rewards are a ten-way random pick of weight 10 each: alloys 5000 (twice), energy 8000, minerals 8000, food 8000, minor artifacts 300, rare crystals 500, volatile motes 500, consumer goods 5000, exotic gases 500 (events/caravaneer_events.txt:4338-4352). It is obtained from the Reliquaries of the Coalition menu (event-cara-333).

texts.zh: [From.From.GetName]认输了，无上的银河之星已经易居我手！
texts.en: The [From.From.GetName] has admitted defeat, and we have wrested the glorious Galatron from their unworthy grasp!

label.en: May its gentle light shine forever.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现那个帝国的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of the other empire appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：通过战争目标 wg_take_galatron / wg_steal_galatron（及帝国版）夺得迦拉特隆时弹出，并设成就旗标 relic_robbery_achievement。
notes.en: Commentary: shown when the Galatron is seized through the war goals wg_take_galatron / wg_steal_galatron (and the imperium versions); it sets the achievement flag relic_robbery_achievement.

texts.zh: 无视败者的癫狂咆哮，[From.GetAdj]军队接管银河之星的仪式不过平淡无奇。
texts.en: Aside from numerous functionaries breaking down into hysterics during the handover, the surrendering of the Galatron to [From.GetAdj] forces was an uneventful affair.

label.zh: 千言万语尽化作无声愤怒。

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现敌对一方的形容词。
note.en: In the game, the adjective for the rival side appears here.

notes.zh: 评注：失去迦拉特隆的一方弹出，并获得3600天的“颜面扫地”(humiliated) 修正。
notes.en: Commentary: shown to the side that loses the Galatron; it gets the humiliated modifier for 3600 days.

summary.text:
# 银河之星 / The Galatron

> 本文为人工审阅导读（评注），不是游戏原文；原文见阅读器。 / Reviewer guide (commentary), not original game text; the original text is in the reader.

- 分类 Category：C8 银河轶事 / Galactic miscellany
- 来源 Sources：`events/caravaneer_events.txt:4131-4356`; `common/relics/relics.txt:405-452`; `common/war_goals/00_war_goals.txt:1680-1683,2028-2043`
- 审阅 Reviewed：2026-10-13（已审阅 reviewed）

## 如何开始 How it starts

迦拉特隆是行商联盟圣物箱里极稀有的奖品（1/200，全银河仅一件）。持有者激活遗物 r_galatron 时弹出 cara.970；通过战争目标夺取或被夺取时分别弹出 cara.950 / cara.951。

The Galatron is the very rare Reliquary prize of the Coalition (1/200, a single one in the galaxy). Its holder activating the relic r_galatron gets cara.970; seizing or losing it through the war goals fires cara.950 / cara.951.

## 剧情脉络 Story outline

三个互不相连的窗口：激活奖励（cara.970）、夺取（cara.950）、失去（cara.951）。另有背景脉冲 cara.960：持有 galatron_modifier 的国家有40%概率得到一份随机资源奖励或永久的海军容量+10。

Three unconnected windows: activation reward (cara.970), seizing (cara.950), losing (cara.951). A background pulse cara.960 also gives the holder (galatron_modifier) a 40% chance of a random resource gift or a permanent +10 naval capacity.

## 分支与结局 Branches and outcomes

无选择分支；970 的奖励为随机。

No choice branches; the reward of 970 is random.

## 条件与文明差异 Conditions and variants

970 的正文有11种（cara.970.1–11.desc）。

The text of 970 has 11 variants (cara.970.1–11.desc).

## 审阅记录 Review notes

核对了遗物定义、三个事件与战争目标调用；cara.960 为隐藏脉冲，只在评注中说明。

The relic definition, the three events and the war-goal callers were checked; cara.960 is a hidden pulse mentioned only here.
